name: pokerst8ts
description: PokerSt8ts — a solo card/board game by Strategic Titans

scripts.package: vite build && rm -f pokerst8ts-v1.0.0.zip && cd dist && zip -r ../pokerst8ts-v1.0.0.zip . && cd .. && echo 'Packaged: pokerst8ts-v1.0.0.zip'
scripts.package:windows: vite build && rm -rf pokerst8ts-windows-v1.0.0 pokerst8ts-windows-v1.0.0.zip && mkdir -p pokerst8ts-windows-v1.0.0 && cp -r dist pokerst8ts-windows-v1.0.0/ && cp server/server.js server/package.json 'server/Play PokerSt8ts.bat' pokerst8ts-windows-v1.0.0/ && zip -r pokerst8ts-windows-v1.0.0.zip pokerst8ts-windows-v1.0.0 && echo 'Packaged: pokerst8ts-windows-v1.0.0.zip'
